title: 公开真实生态学论文检索试验集
notice: Developer-authored expected labels, not an expert gold standard. This pilot checks retrieval of predefined source phrases, not scientific review accuracy or whether evidence supports a generated answer. Chinese questions retain English source terms and do not establish general cross-language retrieval. No expected-no-hit cases are claimed.
